analysis.notes: Final diff is from linked commits and includes substantial unrelated changes (markdownlint config, cliff.toml, CHANGELOG, LICENSE, CLAUDE.md pointer to the template) that appear to have been made outside this session; the template file itself is truncated out of the diff shown. analysis.task_statement: Wire the repo's `.claude/agents/pr-reviewer.md` subagent into GitHub Actions CI so that it runs on pull requests and posts its review as a PR comment, using an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret rather than the Claude GitHub App. Commit, open a PR, debug CI failures until a comment is actually posted, and merge. As a separate follow-up, assess the structure of the existing ADRs in docs/adr and derive a template at docs/adr/0000-template.md.
